title: Bubble Shooter
description: Aim and fire colourful bubbles. Match three or more of the same colour to pop them, and drop whole clusters for huge combos before the bubbles reach the bottom.
instructions: Aim with the mouse or your finger, then click or release to shoot.
Keyboard: Left and Right arrows aim, Space shoots.
Bounce shots off the side walls.
Match 3+ bubbles of the same colour to pop them.
